cr_data.provenance:
[1] By April 11, 1961, (The Downtown Gallery, New York, New York, USA); [2] May 4, 1961, purchased by Mrs. Harry Lynde (Margaret, or Peg, Blakney Sullivan) Bradley [1894–1978] (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA); [3] June or December 1969, gift to The Bradley Family Foundation; 1977, gift to Milwaukee Art Center (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) 
NOTES: 
[1] Downtown Gallery, Georgia O'Keefe: Recent Paintings & Drawings (New York: The Downtown Gallery, 1961), cat. 3. 
[2] Invoice addressed to Mrs. Harry Lynde Bradley in MAM object file, marked paid by “Mrs. B.” on June 26, 196. See also Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonne. Vol. 2 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 850, cat. 1358. 
[3] Documentation from The Bradley Family Foundation in MAM object file; both dates are listed on different sources. See also Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonne. Vol. 2 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 850, cat. 1358. 
(Source: MAM, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Titled *It Was Red and Pink* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
